understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete every level by moving each selectable piece onto a goal tile marked +, with all goals occupied simultaneously so the game reports WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved one grid cell per directional action, while walls could block movement and pushable blocks could be shifted when adjacent. Multiple selectable pieces could be controlled by CLICKing their exact pixel/grid coordinates; movement applied only to the currently selected piece. The blocked indicators were only hints, so actions sometimes had to be tested.
